CustomField.label: Apex Class
CustomField.description: The API name of the Apex class to run for this check. Required when "Evaluation Type" is "Verify with Apex". The class must implement the RecordHealthCheckPlugin interface. Example: AccountApprovalHealthCheck.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required for "Verify with Apex". The Apex class name to run, e.g. AccountApprovalHealthCheck. It must implement RecordHealthCheckPlugin.
